00:24:47.760 --> 00:24:49.560
Okay, let's have a look

476
00:24:49.560 --> 00:24:52.800
and we can see what your answers should have included.

477
00:24:52.800 --> 00:24:55.950
Period, this is also called menstruation,

478
00:24:55.950 --> 00:24:57.660
a natural biological process

479
00:24:57.660 --> 00:25:00.480
that most females go through in their lives.

480
00:25:00.480 --> 00:25:01.920
Period shaming.

481
00:25:01.920 --> 00:25:03.390
This is negative behaviour

482
00:25:03.390 --> 00:25:06.183
or attitudes towards females who have periods.

483
00:25:07.140 --> 00:25:08.340
Menstrual health.

484
00:25:08.340 --> 00:25:11.940
This is a human right, including access to information,

485
00:25:11.940 --> 00:25:15.543
menstrual products, water, sanitation and disposal.

486
00:25:16.410 --> 00:25:17.940
Period positive.

487
00:25:17.940 --> 00:25:20.182
This is a change in behaviours or attitudes

488
00:25:20.182 --> 00:25:22.530
so that females who have periods

489
00:25:22.530 --> 00:25:25.080
always feel valued and included.

490
00:25:25.080 --> 00:25:27.360
And finally, menstrual products.

491
00:25:27.360 --> 00:25:28.650
This is a term to be used

492
00:25:28.650 --> 00:25:31.770
instead of feminine hygiene or sanitary products.

493
00:25:31.770 --> 00:25:33.240
Well done if you got this right

494
00:25:33.240 --> 00:25:34.863
or if you had something similar.

495
00:25:36.488 --> 00:25:38.280
We are now going to summarise the key learning

496
00:25:38.280 --> 00:25:39.483
from today's lesson.

497
00:25:40.590 --> 00:25:42.420
Today, we have learned that menarche

498
00:25:42.420 --> 00:25:45.600
is the time when a female has their first period.

499
00:25:45.600 --> 00:25:48.870
At first, females may have an irregular cycle,

500
00:25:48.870 --> 00:25:50.640
which is when the gap between periods

501
00:25:50.640 --> 00:25:55.050
is less than 21 days or more than 35 days.

502
00:25:55.050 --> 00:25:57.690
Many factors such as puberty or weight loss

503
00:25:57.690 --> 00:26:00.390
can affect menstrual cycles.

504
00:26:00.390 --> 00:26:02.580
Irregular cycles are quite common,

505
00:26:02.580 --> 00:26:03.870
but a doctor should be seen

506
00:26:03.870 --> 00:26:06.063
if there is a sudden change to the cycle.

507
00:26:07.110 --> 00:26:09.897
Emotions can change a few days before a period,

508
00:26:09.897 --> 00:26:11.730
and this is okay.

509
00:26:11.730 --> 00:26:14.400
There are lots of things that can help females to cope

510
00:26:14.400 --> 00:26:17.100
such as exercise and sleep.

511
00:26:17.100 --> 00:26:19.800
We've also learned that periods are not shameful.

512
00:26:19.800 --> 00:26:22.350
They are a natural biological process.

513
00:26:22.350 --> 00:26:24.300
By being period positive,

514
00:26:24.300 --> 00:26:27.840
females who have periods can feel valued and included.

515
00:26:27.840 --> 00:26:30.330
For example, we should use positive body language

516
00:26:30.330 --> 00:26:31.977
when talking about periods

517
00:26:31.977 --> 00:26:34.173
and we shouldn't hide menstrual products.

518
00:26:36.270 --> 00:26:39.510
In today's lesson, we've talked about some tricky topics

519
00:26:39.510 --> 00:26:43.170
and you might find that you have some questions or worries.

520
00:26:43.170 --> 00:26:45.150
If you do have any worries or concerns

521
00:26:45.150 --> 00:26:47.670
about anything we've talked about in today's lesson,

522
00:26:47.670 --> 00:26:50.940
please reach out to a trusted adult who can help you.

523
00:26:50.940 --> 00:26:53.430
There are also some organisations on the screen

524
00:26:53.430 --> 00:26:55.630
who are there to support you if you need it.

525
00:26:56.610 --> 00:26:58.860
Well done for your hard work today.

526
00:26:58.860 --> 00:27:00.540
You've done a fantastic job

527
00:27:00.540 --> 00:27:02.190
and I hope to see you again soon.
